title: Fix an event listener leak
prompt: Our server's memory grows over time and Node prints 'MaxListenersExceededWarning'. The cause is in src/subscriptions.js: every call to `watch()` adds a listener that is never removed. Make `watch(bus, topic, handler)` return an `unsubscribe` function that removes exactly that listener, make the returned function idempotent, and make `watchOnce` remove its listener after the first matching event. Do not change the bus implementation.
